projection_policy.2048: Bounded Mode 1/Mode 2 Form 1 logical user-data bytes, clipped to the candidate length.
projection_policy.2336: Bytes 16..2351 of each complete validated Mode 2 sector, clipped to candidate length; includes XA subheaders and redundant/check bytes.
projection_policy.selection: Use 2048 when its candidate final sector has the measured XA EOF; otherwise use the corroborated 2336 candidate. Both must fit before the next start. This is an explicit byte projection, not a recovered game-loader size convention.

comparison.interpretation: Equality of the explicit unit/length/SHA256 projection key only. These are physical-byte relationships; they neither count unique gameplay content nor establish equivalent behavior.

limitations: Equal unit/length/SHA256 means equal selected source-byte projections, not equal gameplay behavior or unique original content IDs.
Duplicate and zero-byte projections remain separate source slots; their loader/game meaning is unresolved.
The 2336-byte projection is not an audio/video decoder or media asset count.
Private prefixes aid direct inspection and must not enter public metadata or distributed assets.
No native extractor, decoder, loader or game implementation is provided.
